title: Second-hand fashion
subtitle: 「二手時尚／二手衣物／轉售時裝／古著／循環時尚」，究竟是哪一種 second-hand fashion？
description: 「二手時尚／二手衣物／轉售時裝／古著／循環時尚」，究竟是哪一種 second-hand fashion？

words.meaning: 二手衣物；曾被他人擁有的服裝
words.note: 使用者提供。這是 second-hand fashion 最直接、最中性的核心改寫之一。pre-owned clothing 特別強調衣物曾由其他人擁有，但現在再次出售或穿著；語氣通常比 used clothing 更柔和、更商業化。
words.example: The shop specialises in pre-owned clothing from well-known brands.

exercises.original: The boutique sells second-hand fashion from designer labels.
exercises.zh: 這間精品店售賣設計師品牌的二手衣物。
exercises.upgrade: pre-owned clothing · 二手衣物；曾被他人擁有的服裝

options.explanation: designer labels + boutique retail context makes pre-owned clothing the natural polished wording.
最普通、直白的二手衣物稱呼。 但本題的具體線索是 designer garments previously owned by someone else；本句重點是 garments 曾有 previous owner，而語氣偏中性／商業。 因此 second-hand clothing 不是最佳答案。
較功能性，常見於慈善、回收、出口、批發等實務語境。 但本題的具體線索是 designer garments previously owned by someone else；本句重點是 garments 曾有 previous owner，而語氣偏中性／商業。 因此 used clothing 不是最佳答案。
具體指作為商業轉售庫存／商品處理的衣物。 但本題的具體線索是 designer garments previously owned by someone else；本句重點是 garments 曾有 previous owner，而語氣偏中性／商業。 因此 resale clothing 不是最佳答案。
正面、婉轉、行銷式稱呼，強調衣物曾被使用／珍愛。 但本題的具體線索是 designer garments previously owned by someone else；本句重點是 garments 曾有 previous owner，而語氣偏中性／商業。 因此 pre-loved clothing 不是最佳答案。
有年代、復古風格或收藏價值的舊衣；不是所有二手衣物。 但本題的具體線索是 designer garments previously owned by someone else；本句重點是 garments 曾有 previous owner，而語氣偏中性／商業。 因此 vintage clothing 不是最佳答案。

words.meaning: 轉售時裝；二手轉售服飾
words.note: 使用者提供。resale fashion 比 pre-owned clothing 更強調服裝進入轉售市場、平台或商業生態。常見於 fashion industry、online marketplace、retail trend 的語境。

exercises.original: Second-hand fashion has grown rapidly on online marketplaces.

options.explanation: online marketplaces + market growth points to the resale sector, not merely individual used garments.
具體指作為商業轉售庫存／商品處理的衣物。 但本題的具體線索是 growth of the commercial resale market；本句在談 online marketplaces、retailer investment 或 market expansion，焦點是轉售產業本身。 因此 resale clothing 不是最佳答案。
中性、商業化地表示曾由他人擁有的衣物。 但本題的具體線索是 growth of the commercial resale market；本句在談 online marketplaces、retailer investment 或 market expansion，焦點是轉售產業本身。 因此 pre-owned clothing 不是最佳答案。

更廣的可持續模式，涵蓋 resale、repair、rental、reuse、recycling。 但本題的具體線索是 growth of the commercial resale market；本句在談 online marketplaces、retailer investment 或 market expansion，焦點是轉售產業本身。 因此 circular fashion 不是最佳答案。

words.meaning: 循環時尚；循環服裝模式
words.note: 更廣、偏可持續發展。circular fashion 不等於 second-hand fashion 本身，而是涵蓋延長衣物壽命、轉售、維修、租賃、再製與回收的整體模式。當 second-hand fashion 被放在循環經濟框架下時可作近義方向。
words.example: Resale is one important part of circular fashion.

exercises.original: The brand sees second-hand fashion as part of a wider model involving repair, resale, and recycling.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；pre-owned clothing 較中性、商業化，直接指曾由他人擁有的衣物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The boutique sells pre-owned clothing. Second-hand fashion is growing rapidly online.

falseSynonyms.zh: resale fashion 更強調商業轉售市場、平台與產業趨勢；second-hand fashion 也可只是衣物本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Resale fashion is attracting major retailers. She buys second-hand clothes from charity shops.

falseSynonyms.zh: used clothing 更功能性、直白，常見於慈善、回收、出口或批發；不一定帶 fashion/style 語感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The charity sorts used clothing for export. The boutique markets second-hand fashion to young shoppers.

falseSynonyms.zh: vintage clothing 只指具有一定年代、風格或收藏價值的舊衣；不是所有二手衣物都算 vintage。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The shop sells 1970s vintage clothing. Most second-hand clothing is not vintage.

falseSynonyms.zh: thrifted clothing 強調從 thrift/charity shop 等渠道淘來，語氣較口語；二手衣物本身不一定是 thrifted。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She styles thrifted clothing on social media. The resale platform sells pre-owned designer items.

falseSynonyms.zh: pre-loved clothing 是較溫和、正面的行銷用語；second-hand 更中性直接。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The boutique promotes pre-loved clothing. The survey asks whether people buy second-hand clothing.

falseSynonyms.zh: circular fashion 更廣，包含 resale、repair、rental、reuse 和 recycling；second-hand fashion 只是其中一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Repair and resale are parts of circular fashion. Second-hand fashion focuses on previously owned garments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者不是同義詞。fast fashion 是快速、大量、低成本生產與消費模式；second-hand fashion 是衣物再次流通。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fast fashion relies on rapid product turnover. Second-hand fashion extends garment use.
